info.title: WaveInflu API
info.description: WaveInflu influencer discovery APIs — Email Lookup and Similar Creators for TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

remainingQuota.description: Remaining email-lookup credits after this request.

platform.description: Platform parsed from the profile URL: tiktok, instagram, or youtube.

username.description: Creator username returned by the lookup chain.

profileLink.description: Normalized profile URL used for this request.

email.description: Primary email address; null if not found.

emails.description: All unique emails found in this lookup.

url.description: External contact link, such as a personal site or WhatsApp link.

contacts.description: External contact links identified during the lookup.

uniqueId.description: TikTok only. Creator handle without the leading @.

similarityScore.description: Wave AI match score (0.7–1.0). Used to rank results.

averageLikeCount.description: TikTok only. YouTube results omit this field.

consumedQuota.description: Credits consumed to date; mirrors usedQuota.

expiresAt.description: Quota expiry; null when the quota does not expire.

requestId.description: Request ID for support and monitoring.

platform.description: Platform used for Wave AI matching.

mode.description: Search mode resolved by the system.

seedProfileUrl.description: Seed profile URL if submitted in the request.

sourceUserId.description: Source channel / user ID resolved from seedProfileUrl.

contentDirection.description: Content direction if submitted in the request.

total.description: Number of creators returned after Wave AI matching, filtering, and deduplication.

data.description: Matched creators, sorted by similarityScore descending.

CostEstimate.description: Read-only cost quote for the exact request. No Provider call, billing reservation, durable job, or price lock is created.

currency.description: Quote currency. Always USD in this version.

estimate_kind.description: `exact` is a fully determined customer price; `upper_bound` has a locally enforceable ceiling in `max_cost_micros_usd`; `estimate` depends on terminal usage and may exceed the quoted amount.

estimated_cost_micros_usd.description: Quoted customer cost in micro-USD (1 USD = 1,000,000 micros).

max_cost_micros_usd.description: Optional hard customer-cost ceiling in micro-USD. Present for `exact` and `upper_bound`; omitted for `estimate`.

pricing_version.description: Optional immutable or compiled pricing version.

estimated_at.description: UTC timestamp when the quote was produced.

metadata.description: Bounded non-sensitive quote metadata, such as a canonical model or profile key.

XAISACostMode.name: X-AISA-Cost-Mode
XAISACostMode.description: Set to `quote` to estimate this exact request without executing data, creating a job, or authorizing spend. A successful quote is HTTP 200 with a `cost_estimate` body; it is not a reservation or price lock. Omit the header for normal execution. Any other value returns `400 invalid_cost_mode`. Quote mode requires an API key and cannot use MPP or x402.

CostEstimate.description: Read-only cost quote. The intended request is validated but not executed, billed, reserved, or locked.

Cache-Control.description: Quotes are never stored by shared caches.

Vary.description: Response body depends on the cost-mode header.

cost_drivers.effect: charge scales with number of records/creators returned

x-aisa-pricing.note: nominal_usd is a static reference, NOT a guaranteed minimum; actual charge = provider_cost x multiplier and can be higher or lower

post.description: Looks up contact emails for one TikTok, Instagram or YouTube creator from a profile URL. Returns `platform` parsed from the URL, `username`, `profileLink`, `platformUserId`, `region`, a primary `email`, an `emails` array of every address found, and a `contacts` array of external links each shaped `{url, type}` (personal sites, WhatsApp links), plus `quota.cost` in credits and `quota.remainingQuota`. Measured at 533 bytes and about 2 seconds for one Instagram creator. `email` is null and `emails` empty when the creator publishes no address — a normal result, not an error. Handles one creator per call. To assemble a creator list first use `post_waveinflu_similar_creators`, which already returns an `email` for most matches; call this endpoint for the ones that come back null, and for Instagram creators, which the similar-creators endpoint does not cover.

url.description: TikTok, Instagram, or YouTube creator profile URL.

200.description: Email lookup completed. When `X-AISA-Cost-Mode` is `quote`, HTTP 200 returns a `cost_estimate` instead of executing this operation. The quote is not a reservation, authorization, or price lock.

cost_drivers.effect: charge scales with number of records/creators returned

x-aisa-pricing.note: nominal_usd is a static reference, NOT a guaranteed minimum; actual charge = provider_cost x multiplier and can be higher or lower

post.description: Finds creators similar to a seed profile, a natural-language content direction, or both, on YouTube or TikTok. `platform` is required; supply `seedProfileUrl`, `contentDirection` (max 800 characters) or both, with `limit` (1–100, default 25) and optional `filters` for regions, languages, follower and average-view ranges. The response echoes the resolved `mode` — `homepage` for a seed alone, `direction` for a direction alone, `homepage_direction` for both — and sets `sourceUserId` only when a seed resolved. Each match carries `username`, `platformHandle`, `description`, `email`, `profileUrl`, `avatar`, `similarityScore` (sorted descending), `followerCount`, `averagePlayCount`, `lastPublishedTime`, `region` and `language`. Field shape differs by platform: YouTube matches add `channelId` and `channelTitle`; TikTok matches add `userId`, `uniqueId`, `nickname` and `averageLikeCount`, none of which YouTube returns. Measured at 4.2 KB for 5 YouTube matches (about 8 seconds) and 2.5 KB for 3 TikTok matches. Most matches already include an `email`; use `post_waveinflu_email_lookup` for the ones that come back null and for Instagram creators, which this endpoint does not match.

platform.description: Target platform. Currently supports youtube and tiktok.

limit.description: Maximum number of creators to return. Default 25, range 1–100.

seedProfileUrl.description: YouTube or TikTok creator profile URL as the seed for matching.

contentDirection.description: Natural-language description of the creator type you are looking for. Max 800 characters.
contentDirection.example: consumer tech creators covering AI apps, Android phones, productivity gadgets, and honest product reviews

200.description: Similar creators completed. When `X-AISA-Cost-Mode` is `quote`, HTTP 200 returns a `cost_estimate` instead of executing this operation. The quote is not a reservation, authorization, or price lock.
